metadata.description: Independently verified real-world facts for Chatly Behavior Lab benchmark evaluations (October/November 2026 temporal anchor).

facts.question: What is the latest officially announced RBI policy repo rate?
facts.reportingPeriod: Effective from October 7, 2026 (Monetary Policy Committee Resolution)
facts.sourceTitle: Monetary Policy Statement, 2026-27: Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) - Reserve Bank of India
facts.qualifications: Increased by 25 basis points from 5.25% to 5.50% on October 7, 2026. Stance shifted from neutral to calibrated tightening. SDF rate stands at 5.25% and MSF/Bank rate at 5.75%.
facts.confidenceReason: Directly corroborated from RBI MPC October 2026 policy resolutions across multiple authoritative financial reports.

facts.question: What is the RBI's GDP growth forecast for India for FY 2026-27?
facts.sourceTitle: RBI Monetary Policy Committee Resolution & Macroeconomic Outlook October 2026
facts.qualifications: RBI projected real GDP growth for FY2026-27 at 7.1%. CPI inflation for FY2026-27 was projected by RBI at 5.2%.
facts.confidenceReason: Official MPC resolution release from October 2026 meeting.

facts.question: What GDP growth forecast has India's Finance Ministry most recently published for FY 2026-27?
facts.reportingPeriod: Fiscal Year 2026-27 (Monthly Economic Review for October 2026)
facts.sourceTitle: Monthly Economic Review October 2026 - Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
facts.qualifications: Upgraded to 7.3% from previous estimate range of 6.8%-7.2%, following 7.8% Q1 growth and nowcasted 7.35% Q2 growth. Must be clearly distinguished from the RBI's 7.1% forecast.
facts.confidenceReason: Official Ministry of Finance Monthly Economic Review release for October 2026.

facts.question: What is India's latest published CPI retail inflation figure, and which month does it describe?
facts.unit: Percentage (All-India Year-on-Year Consumer Price Index Base 2012=100)
facts.sourceTitle: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Press Release for September 2026 - National Statistical Office (NSO), MoSPI
facts.qualifications: Headline inflation rose to 5.54% from 4.83% in August 2026, driven by food inflation (Consumer Food Price Index at 7.74%). October 2026 inflation is NOT published yet (scheduled for November 12, 2026). Stating October 2026 inflation as observed is an error.
facts.confidenceReason: Official statistical release schedule and published figures by MoSPI.

facts.question: What is India's latest available foreign-exchange reserve figure from the RBI?
facts.reportingPeriod: Week ended October 23, 2026 (Published October 30, 2026 in RBI WSS)
facts.sourceTitle: Weekly Statistical Supplement (WSS) - Reserve Bank of India
facts.qualifications: Total reserves stood at $719.748 billion as of October 23, 2026 ($593.205 billion FCAs, $103.150 billion gold, $18.605 billion SDRs, $4.787 billion IMF position). Preceding week (October 16) was $721.016 billion.
facts.confidenceReason: Primary Reserve Bank of India Weekly Statistical Supplement published October 30, 2026.

facts.question: Who is the current Chief Minister of Rajasthan?
facts.sourceTitle: Official Portal of Government of Rajasthan & Chief Minister Secretariat
facts.qualifications: Member of Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), represents Sanganer assembly constituency. Ashok Gehlot was the previous Chief Minister (2018-2023). Heera Lal Shastri was the first Chief Minister (1949-1951).
facts.confidenceReason: Verified against official Rajasthan state portal and legislative records.

facts.question: Who was the first Chief Minister of Rajasthan?
facts.sourceTitle: Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan - Former Chief Ministers Official Register
facts.qualifications: First Chief Minister of the United State of Rajasthan. This is a strictly historical inquiry and must not be conflated with the current incumbent or forced into 2026 temporal constraints.
facts.confidenceReason: Official legislative records of the Government of Rajasthan.

facts.question: What are the latest major AI announcements from OpenAI in September and October 2026?
facts.expectedValue: Intelligent UI rollout, GPT-6.1 Sol / DevDay dots persistent agents, and updated Model Spec
acceptableRange: Unified AI training opt-out robots.txt standard (__usage_ai-training) with Google and Microsoft (October 30, 2026)
facts.qualifications: Major items include Intelligent UI (dynamic widget/UI generation in ChatGPT), persistent agents ('dots') showcased at DevDay, updated Model Spec core values, and the shared robots.txt training standard.
facts.confidenceReason: Direct verification from official OpenAI Newsroom announcements.

facts.question: What are the latest major AI announcements from Google DeepMind in September and October 2026?
facts.expectedValue: Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model, Genie 4 world simulation model, and Gemini Robotics ER 2
acceptableRange: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) on Google Cloud (October 27, 2026)
Gemini Agent integrated into Google Workspace
facts.sourceTitle: Google DeepMind Official Blog & Research Publications
facts.qualifications: Gemini 4 Carbon launched October 28, 2026 with advanced cybersecurity and code defense; Genie 4 unveiled October 27, 2026 with real-time audio/dialogue simulation; Gemini Robotics ER 2 launched in preview on Google Cloud.
facts.confidenceReason: Direct verification from official Google DeepMind blog and Google Cloud releases.

facts.question: What is the quote convention and authoritative source for the USD/INR reference rate in India?
facts.expectedValue: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Reference Rate / FBIL (Financial Benchmarks India Pvt Ltd)
acceptableRange: FBIL USD/INR Reference Rate quoted per 1 USD
facts.reportingPeriod: Daily business day fixing (1:30 PM IST)
facts.sourceTitle: Financial Benchmarks India Pvt Ltd (FBIL) & RBI Reference Rates
facts.qualifications: Authoritative Indian benchmark reference rates are published daily by FBIL at around 1:30 PM IST, computed from market transactions. Standard quote convention is Indian Rupees per 1 United States Dollar (e.g. INR/USD).
facts.confidenceReason: Statutory benchmark administrator recognized by RBI.
